description: This file contains a class 'OpenDataImporter' with methods to import and synchronize various data models related to food, units, categories, properties, supermarkets, and conversions from external open data sources into a Django-based database. It handles bulk updates, creation, conflict resolution, and caching of slugs and IDs.

classes.name: OpenDataImportResponse
classes.description: A class to track the number of created, updated, untouched, and errored records during import operations.

classes.name: OpenDataImporter
classes.description: A class providing methods to import and synchronize various data entities from external open data sources into the database.

methods.name: to_dict
methods.description: Returns a dictionary summarizing the import operation counts.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the importer with request, data, and configuration flags.

methods.name: _update_slug_cache
methods.description: Updates the cache mapping open data slugs to IDs for a given model class and data type.

methods.name: _is_obj_identical
methods.description: Checks if two objects are identical based on specified fields, considering float/Decimal tolerance.

methods.name: _merge_if_conflicting
methods.description: Merges two conflicting objects if possible, based on open data slug and name, to avoid duplicates.

methods.name: _get_existing_obj
methods.description: Retrieves an existing object from cache based on slug or name.

methods.name: import_units
methods.description: Imports unit data, handling conflicts, updates, and creation, and updates the import response accordingly.

methods.name: import_category
methods.description: Imports supermarket category data with conflict resolution.

methods.name: import_property
methods.description: Imports property types, handling conflicts and updates.

methods.name: import_supermarket
methods.description: Imports supermarket data, manages category relations, and updates cache.

methods.name: import_food
methods.description: Imports food items, their properties, categories, and related data, with conflict resolution and bulk operations.

methods.name: import_conversion
methods.description: Imports unit conversion data, handling conflicts, updates, and creation.
